title: Orders Reporting Feature

tasks.title: Update Sidebar Component
tasks.description: Add Reports navigation link to Sidebar.js with Font Awesome icon and active route logic.
tasks.testingApproach: Unit test for link rendering and active state using React Testing Library
tasks.implementationDetails: Import necessary icons, add NavLink to /reports with matching Tailwind classes from existing items, ensure collapse behavior preserved

tasks.title: Verify Sidebar Styling
tasks.description: Ensure new item follows exact existing CSS and responsive rules.
tasks.testingApproach: Manual visual check in desktop browser and snapshot test
tasks.implementationDetails: Reuse App.css classes, confirm hover and active states match other nav items

stories.title: Add Reports Navigation Item
stories.userStory: As an authenticated user, I want to see a Reports item in the sidebar so that I can access the orders reporting feature.
stories.description: Add a new Reports navigation item to the existing sidebar that matches current styling and behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Given I am authenticated, when I view the sidebar, then a Reports link appears with correct styling and icon
Given the sidebar is collapsed, when I expand it, then the Reports item is visible and clickable
Given I am on the Reports page, when viewing the sidebar, then the Reports item is highlighted as active

tasks.title: Register Reports Route
tasks.description: Add protected route in App.js using existing auth guard.
tasks.testingApproach: Integration test for route protection and navigation
tasks.implementationDetails: Use react-router-dom v6, wrap with existing isAuthenticated check from localStorage

tasks.title: Create Reports Component Skeleton
tasks.description: Build Reports.js with filter section and placeholder table.
tasks.testingApproach: Unit tests for initial render state
tasks.implementationDetails: Use React hooks, import existing mock orders, follow desktop-first responsive layout

stories.title: Implement Reports Route and Page
stories.userStory: As an authenticated user, I want to navigate to /reports so that I can access the report configuration view.
stories.description: Create protected /reports route and basic Reports page component.
acceptanceCriteria: Given I click Reports in sidebar, when navigating, then /reports loads the Reports component
Given I am unauthenticated, when accessing /reports, then I am redirected to login
Given the page loads, when rendered, then it shows filter controls and empty table initially

tasks.title: Implement Filter Inputs
tasks.description: Add date inputs and status checkboxes with state management.
tasks.testingApproach: Unit tests for input changes and validation
tasks.implementationDetails: Use native date inputs in ISO format, controlled components with useState, multi-select via checkboxes

tasks.title: Add Filtering Logic with useMemo
tasks.description: Calculate filtered results and summary counts on filter changes.
tasks.testingApproach: Unit tests for calculation correctness with various filter combinations
tasks.implementationDetails: Import orders from mock module, filter by date and status array, compute counts and date coverage

tasks.title: Handle Apply and Clear Actions
tasks.description: Wire buttons to trigger calculations and reset.
tasks.implementationDetails: Prevent invalid date submissions, show success/error toasts via react-toastify

stories.title: Build Filter Controls and Report Generation
stories.userStory: As an operations manager, I want to select date range and statuses then apply filters so that the summary table updates instantly.
stories.description: Implement date range picker, status multi-select, apply/clear buttons with client-side filtering.
acceptanceCriteria: Given filters are set to valid values, when clicking Apply Filters, then table shows correct aggregated data using useMemo
Given invalid date range, when applying, then error toast displays
Given filters applied, when clicking Clear Filters, then all selections reset and table empties

tasks.title: Build Table Component
tasks.description: Create semantic table with totals row and empty state.
tasks.testingApproach: Unit and accessibility tests for table structure
tasks.implementationDetails: Use ARIA labels, Tailwind responsive classes, display data from useMemo result

stories.title: Render Summary Report Table
stories.userStory: As a user, I want to see the summary table with counts and totals so that I get instant visual feedback on orders.
stories.description: Display status breakdown table with totals row and empty state handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Given matching orders, when filters applied, then table shows Status, Count, Date Range columns plus grand total
Given no matching orders, when filters applied, then empty state message is shown
Given table data, when rendered, then it is responsive on desktop

tasks.title: Implement Toast Calls
tasks.description: Integrate toast notifications on apply and error paths.
tasks.implementationDetails: Use existing react-toastify setup with appropriate messages and durations

tasks.title: Apply Accessibility Enhancements
tasks.description: Add ARIA, labels, keyboard support and contrast checks.
tasks.testingApproach: Accessibility audit with keyboard and screen reader simulation
tasks.implementationDetails: Ensure semantic HTML, focus management, and match existing app WCAG patterns

stories.title: Integrate Toast Notifications and Accessibility
stories.userStory: As a user, I want clear feedback and accessible controls so that the feature is usable and compliant.
stories.description: Add success/error toasts and ensure WCAG 2.1 AA compliance.
acceptanceCriteria: Given successful report, when generated, then success toast appears via react-toastify
Given error condition, when triggered, then error toast appears
Given keyboard navigation, when using filters and table, then all elements are fully operable

description: Adds a client-side Reports section to the React SPA allowing authenticated users to filter existing mock orders by date range and status, view instant summary tables with counts and totals, and receive toast feedback, all without backend changes.
